## History

Martin is a minor figure in the community surrounding [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). He is present in the neighborhood during the period of mourning following Matthew's sudden death from shock over a bank failure. Along with other friends and neighbors, he gathers to support [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) through the funeral.
